intro: Twelve face hypotheses on the same body, with the same size, color and expression: the only thing that changes is the face. It is a separate bench and does not touch the current bot system.

conteo.tamanos: {{cara}} from 24 to 256 px, on light and dark UI

ideas.ethereal: Edgeless eyes: a gradient that fades out at the border, with a core of light. The face feels inside the material.
ideas.flat: “D” eyes with a flat base and no highlights. Happy without closing them: they squash upward. Built for 24–32 px.
ideas.line: Everything is a single-weight, round-capped stroke, like one more glyph in the library.
ideas.pastel: Almost-round eyes with two tiny catchlights and low, barely-there cheeks, on pastel bodies.
ideas.solid: Perfect indigo discs. Color only comes in as one graphic piece: pink, cyan, green or coral depending on the expression.
ideas.neu: Sockets carved into the material —shadow above, a light edge below— with the pupil inside.
ideas.vibrant: Tall, maximum-contrast slabs on an intense gradient body with a colored halo.
ideas.mask: A thick, open arc crosses the face and holds eyes and mouth; it trims to each shape’s width. On the robot it is the visor.
ideas.gel: Each eye wears its own silicone lens: you see the eye, and the skin over it.
ideas.adaptive: Capsules that stretch, spread, drop and tilt following the measured silhouette.
ideas.dark: Slits of light, one lavender and one cyan, with a faint halo. Built for dark UIs, no neon.
ideas.system: Glyph-like capsules with a single signature trait: the inner top corner cut on a diagonal. No cheeks, highlights or extra color.

nota: Hover a bot: the face follows you a few px and blinks. If the site is set to still or your system asks for reduced motion, everything stays put.
